Part I:  A Guide to Healthy Nutrition
Day 11 Recipe
Banana Raspberry Smoothie
Serves 2
1 1/2 cups pineapple juice
1 cup low-fat vanilla yogurt or frozen low-fat yogurt
1 cup raspberries
2 ripe medium bananas, peeled and cut into chunks
Combine juice, yogurt, raspberries, and bananas in blender.  Cover; blend until
smooth.  Pour into glasses and serve.
